description: Abstract class defining the base for PDF encryption handling within the PDFsharp library, including methods for encryption/decryption, password validation, and handling cryptographic exceptions.

classes.name: PdfEncryptionBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing the foundation for encryption implementations in PDFsharp, managing encryption state, object processing, and password validation.

methods.name: InitializeFromLoadedSecurityHandler
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize encryption settings from a loaded security handler.

methods.name: EnterObject
methods.description: Abstract method called when a PDF object is entered for encryption or decryption.

methods.name: LeaveObject
methods.description: Abstract method called when leaving a PDF object during encryption or decryption.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Abstract method to encrypt bytes for the current PDF object.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Abstract method to decrypt bytes for the current PDF object.

methods.name: PrepareEncryptionForSaving
methods.description: Abstract method to set encryption parameters before saving the PDF.

methods.name: ValidatePassword
methods.description: Abstract method to validate a given password against the encryption scheme.

methods.name: HandleCryptographicExceptionOnDecryption
methods.description: Handles cryptographic exceptions during decryption, logging warnings if configured to ignore errors.
